description: Source code for the Mattermost server API related to emoji management, including creation, retrieval, deletion, search, and autocomplete functionalities.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Main API struct for handling emoji-related routes and operations.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Context object encapsulating request-specific data, permissions, and application state.

methods.name: InitEmoji
methods.description: Initializes the emoji-related API routes and handlers.

methods.name: createEmoji
methods.description: Handles creation of a new custom emoji.

methods.name: getEmojiList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of emojis with optional sorting.

methods.name: deleteEmoji
methods.description: Deletes a specified emoji, with permission checks.

methods.name: getEmoji
methods.description: Retrieves a specific emoji by ID.

methods.name: getEmojiByName
methods.description: Retrieves an emoji by its name.

methods.name: getEmojisByNames
methods.description: Retrieves multiple emojis by their names.

methods.name: getEmojiImage
methods.description: Fetches the image data for a specific emoji.

methods.name: searchEmojis
methods.description: Searches emojis based on a term.

methods.name: autocompleteEmojis
methods.description: Provides emoji autocomplete suggestions based on a partial name.
